label: What a reduction must preserve
subgoals: Map every instance of A to an instance of B
Preserve yes answers and no answers
Keep the mapping polynomial in time

label: 3-SAT to independent set
subgoals: Make one vertex per literal occurrence
Join the literals of a clause and every complementary pair
Ask for an independent set as large as the clause count

label: Choosing the direction
subgoals: Reduce the known hard problem to the new one to show hardness
Reduce the new problem to a solved one to get an algorithm
Reject arguments that run the arrow backwards
